summary: All plan acceptance, oracles, migration and non-vacuity checks pass, but pnpm run lint fails on a changed file (unused var saleB in settlements-schema.test.ts).
findings: apps/api/test/rls/settlements-schema.test.ts:595 - `const saleB = await insertSale(adminClient, orgB, 1);` is never used, so `pnpm run lint` (eslint) reports `'saleB' is assigned a value but never used` (@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars). Every other unused-but-intentional variable in this same test file is explicitly marked with `void x;` (see `void receivableA2;` and `void receivableD;` a few lines below/above); this one instance was missed. This is a real, reproducible lint failure on a file this slice changed, not a flake.
